cause_quote: The diff added `display var(--motion-sheet) allow-discrete` and `transform: translateY(100%)` for `.chat-mobile-host[hidden]`, keeping the shell visible during an exit while the existing close handler hid the contents immediately.
user_saw: On phones, closing Panels or Details with a tool or page open made the content vanish while an empty gray sheet slid offscreen.
summary: The fix keeps panel and Details content visible until the dismissal animation ends and restores immediate focus when Side chat reopens.
reasoning: I checked the parent of #188162 and confirmed that closing set `open = false` immediately and hid the entire sheet with `display: none`. The new slide-out shipped with that same close logic and preserved only the launcher through a CSS exception, so tool and Details content blanked from the first version of the animation. The related reopen focus issue came from #188810, which subsequently added `visibility var(--motion-sheet)`.
